name: AI Compliance, Law and Regulation
blurb: State AI legislation and federal rulemaking, the frameworks, standards and enforcement records organisations are measured against - ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, SOC 2, the sector rules and the agencies actually bringing cases - and the separate body of siting, zoning and utility law that decides where AI compute may physically be built and who pays for the power it draws.

built.name: This Week in AI Laws and Compliance
built.detail: The week in AI law and compliance: state bills that changed status, Federal Register documents, and AI lawsuits with new docket activity, grouped by subject and computed from the record every day.

built.name: AI Laws by State
built.detail: Every tracked AI bill in all fifty states, DC, Puerto Rico, and Congress, one page per jurisdiction, refreshed daily from LegiScan.

built.name: AI Governance Frameworks
built.detail: ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, SOC 2, the sector rules, and the agency enforcement records, explained in plain English.

built.name: Federal AI Legislation
built.detail: Bills before Congress and federal rulemaking: 614 tracked congressional AI bills refreshed daily from LegiScan, 101 Federal Register documents from the rulemaking watch, the agency enforcement records (FTC, SEC, EEOC, CFPB, HHS OCR), and...

built.name: Global AI Laws
built.detail: The EU AI Act, the EU Cyber Resilience Act and product liability regime, GDPR as applied to AI, DORA, NIS2, China's AI regulations, and the Council of Europe Framework Convention, explained in plain English with the compliance obligations...

built.name: Data Centre Siting, Power and Local Regulation
built.detail: Every other framework in this section governs what an AI system may do. This one governs where it may physically exist and what it may draw from the grid, and almost none of it mentions artificial intelligence.

built.name: Agency Enforcement Actions
built.detail: What federal agencies are actually bringing cases over, under powers they already have.

built.name: Enacted AI Laws
built.detail: Every AI-related bill that has actually become law, detected from the legislative record on the day its status changes, with the state, the date, and the source record for each.

built.name: AI Policy Ledger
built.detail: Every AI law, rule and executive action this site tracks, across the states, the federal government, the EU and China, in one dated table: what it is, where it applies, who it applies to, its effective date, and its penalty ceiling as the...

built.name: EU, US and China Compared
built.detail: The three largest AI regimes side by side on the same questions: who is regulated, how risk is classified, what must be registered or assessed before launch, what must be disclosed, who enforces, and the maximum penalty, each answer cited...

built.name: AI Assurance Standards
built.detail: Which kind of assurance proves what. A management system certificate under ISO/IEC 42001, audited by bodies under ISO/IEC 17021-1 and 42006, attests to how an organisation governs AI. A model capability test is separate evidence about one system.
